cases: Vendor JPEG XL failures on macOS and Windows

ratio_definition: GDAL median elapsed seconds / Terrio median elapsed seconds. Values above 1 mean Terrio is faster; values below 1 mean Terrio is slower. Markdown slower rows display the reciprocal.
pass_definition: An empty validation list means the output gate passed; an empty measurement_issues list means the measurement gate passed. A non-null ratio requires both gates to pass. timing_notes do not change eligibility.
output_gate_definition: Raster sample values (NaNs equal), masks and checked band properties are exact. CRS comparison is semantic; affine transforms allow absolute 1e-8 / relative 1e-12 error. Arbitrary metadata, compression and file-byte identity are outside the gate. Vector attributes/schema and normalized geometry are exact, excluding generated FIDs and layer names.
